description: Create a single use case from a fully-specified payload. Use this to persist use cases returned by muggle-remote-use-case-bulk-preview-submit — no LLM is invoked.

description.description: Description of the use case, including actor and preconditions

projectId.description: Project ID (UUID) the use case belongs to

source.description: How this use case was produced

url.description: URL where the use case takes place (defaults to project URL)

useCaseBreakdown.description: Main/alternative/error flows broken down as requirement + acceptance criteria pairs

acceptanceCriteria.description: Concrete, measurable acceptance criteria for the requirement

requirement.description: One requirement of the use case

userStory.description: One-line user story from the end-user point of view

name: muggle-remote-use-case-create
